units.specificEnthalpy: kJ/kg refrigerant or kJ/kg dry air as named

scope: Static discrete teaching scenario; not calibrated dryer performance or drying-time simulation.
applicability: Only the stated R134a and humid-air inputs are validated. Chart clipping ranges are visualization bounds, not fluid-property validity limits.

refrigerant.calculationMethod: CoolProp PropsSI; saturated pressures at specified evaporating/condensing temperatures; compressor outlet from isentropic reference and specified efficiency; state 3 from subcooling; state 4 from h4=h3.

energyPerKg.statement: q_cond ≈ q_evap + w_comp; unit-mass refrigerant basis, not measured whole-machine COP

humidAir.calculationMethod: CoolProp HAPropsSI at fixed total pressure; states defined by T/RH or T/humidity ratio; RH and enthalpy chart curves recomputed point-by-point.

assumptions.stateDefinition: A evaporator outlet / B condenser outlet / C drum outlet
